topic_title: Cell Biology - The Unit of Life

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Raju, tumhara mobile charge khatam hone par chalta hai?

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Nahi sir... battery low ho jaye to band ho jata hai.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Aur agar screen toot jaye?

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Tab bhi problem... par battery hogi to on to rahega na?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Sahi baat! Mobile ka sabse chhota working part kya hai jo usko actually 'zinda' rakhta hai?

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Chip? Ya circuit board?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Haan! Chip yaani processor - wo sabse chhoti 'working unit' hai. Lekin wo 'alive' nahi hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Matlab sir?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Tumhare body mein bhi ek sabse chhoti unit hai... par wo ALIVE hai! Saans leti hai, khana khati hai, waste nikalti hai!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Kya hai wo sir?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: CELL! Jaise mobile chips se bana hai, waise hi tum CELLS se bane ho! Par farak ye hai - cell LIVING hai! 🧬

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Matlab main cells se bana hoon? Kitni hogi mere mein?

guess_payload.question: Tumhare hisaab se CELL kya hoga?
options: Body ka sabse chhota living part
guess_payload.explanation: Bilkul sahi! CELL = Sabse chhoti LIVING unit jo independently kaam kar sakti hai. Ye khud se breathe karti hai, food digest karti hai, waste nikalti hai!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: 1665 ki baat hai... England mein ek scientist tha Robert Hooke.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Unhone cell discover kiya?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Haan! Usne bottle ki cork (dhakkan wala material) ko magnifying lens se dekha...

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: To kya dikha?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Chhote chhote boxes! Madhumakhi ke chatte jaisa pattern! 🐝 Usne socha ye chhoti kothriyaan hain... isliye naam diya CELL (matlab room).

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Ohh! To cell ka matlab hi chhoti kothri!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: ⚠️ Lekin yahan BPSC ka favorite trap hai!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Kya trap sir?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Hooke ne jo cork dekha tha... wo DEAD cells the! Cork matlab sukha hua plant tissue.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Hain?? To living cell kisne dekha pehli baar?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Uska naam tha Leeuwenhoek (लीवेनहुक). 1674 mein usne pond water dekha... usme living organisms the - bacteria aur protozoa!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: To living cell ka credit isko jana chahiye?

quiz_payload.question: Robert Hooke (1665) ne cell discover karne ke liye kaunsa material use kiya?
quiz_payload.explanation: Cork! Hooke ne bottle ke cork mein dead cell walls dekhe. Yaad rakho: Hooke = Cork, 1665, Dead cells. Living cells = Leeuwenhoek (1674).

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Ek aur scientist tha - Robert Brown (1831). Orchid plant ki cells dekh raha tha...

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Usne kya dekha?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Har cell ke beech mein ek dense, round structure - jaise aam ki guthli! 🥭

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Wo kya tha?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: NUCLEUS! Cell ka brain! Par Brown ko nahi pata tha ye kaam kya karta hai... usne bas dekha tha.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Ye scientists ne bas dekhne ka kaam kiya... par cell ka theory kisne banaya?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: 1838-39... do German scientists - Schleiden (plants) aur Schwann (animals) ne ek revolutionary baat kahi!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Kya kaha?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Saari living cheezein CELLS se bani hain! Ye hi hai CELL THEORY ka pehla rule!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Aur kitne rules hain?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Teen golden rules! Pehle tum guess karo... nayi cell kaise banti hogi?

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Kya pata... khud se ban jati hogi?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Galat! Rudolf Virchow (1855) ne prove kiya - nayi cell HAMESHA purani cell se hi banti hai!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Matlab divide hoke?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Exactly! 'Omnis cellula-e-cellula' - har cell ek existing cell se. Jaise ek company ki do branches!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: To teen rules kya hue?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
1️⃣ All living organisms are made of cells (Schleiden+Schwann)
2️⃣ Cell is basic unit of life
3️⃣ New cells arise from pre-existing cells (Virchow)

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sab living organisms matlab... virus bhi?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: ⚠️ Ye BPSC ka sabse bada trap hai!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Kya sir?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: VIRUS mein cell nahi hota! Wo sirf protein coat + DNA/RNA hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: To virus living hai ya non-living?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Dono! Outside host = Non-living (crystal jaisa 💎). Inside host = Living (reproduce karta hai 🔄).

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Confusing hai ye to!

quiz_payload.question: Cell Theory mein 'Omnis cellula-e-cellula' ka contribution kisne diya?
quiz_payload.explanation: Rudolf Virchow (1855) ne. Iska matlab: All cells arise from pre-existing cells. Yaad rakho - Virchow = Cell division concept.

quiz_payload.question: Living cells ko sabse pehle kisne observe kiya?
quiz_payload.explanation: Leeuwenhoek (1674) - Pond water mein bacteria aur protozoa dekhe. Hooke ne sirf dead cells dekhe the cork mein.

milestone_payload.title: 🎉 Cell History Complete!
milestone_payload.milestone_progress:
Hooke (Cork, 1665) ✓
Leeuwenhoek (Living cells, 1674) ✓
Brown (Nucleus, 1831) ✓
Cell Theory (Schleiden, Schwann, Virchow) ✓
milestone_payload.motivational_quote: BPSC mein scientist ke naam aur year se 40% questions bante hain! Tum ready ho! 💪

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Raju, gaon mein kitne type ke ghar hote hain?

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Do type - chhote kacche ghar aur bade pakke ghar.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
Perfect! Cells bhi do type ki hoti hain:
1️⃣ PROKARYOTIC (kaccha ghar - simple)
2️⃣ EUKARYOTIC (pakka ghar - advanced)

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Farak kya hai?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Sabse bada - NUCLEUS! Prokaryotic mein proper nucleus nahi, Eukaryotic mein proper nucleus hai!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Matlab PRO = No nucleus?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: PRO = Before (पहले), KARYON = Nucleus. Matlab nucleus banne se PEHLE wale primitive cells!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: To nucleus hota nahi hai?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Nuclear MEMBRANE nahi hota! DNA freely floating hota hai - nucleoid region mein.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Aur kya nahi hota?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Koi bhi membrane-bound organelle nahi - mitochondria nahi, ER nahi, Golgi nahi! Sirf RIBOSOMES hote hain (70S type).

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Examples?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: BACTERIA aur BLUE-GREEN ALGAE (Cyanobacteria)! Bas itne hi!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Matlab sirf do organism?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Haan! Baaki duniya ke SAARE organisms eukaryotic - tum, main, plants, animals, fungi!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Eukaryotic kya hota hai?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: EU = True/Good, KARYON = Nucleus. Matlab TRUE nucleus wale cells!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Ismein sab organelles honge?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Haan! Well-defined nucleus, mitochondria, ER, Golgi, lysosomes - sab kuch!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Size mein bhi bade honge?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bilkul! Prokaryotic = 0.1-5 μm, Eukaryotic = 10-100 μm.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Ribosomes?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: 80S type ke (prokaryotes se bade)! ⚠️ Ye number exam mein bahut puchha jata hai!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: 70S aur 80S yaad kaise rakhen?

quiz_payload.question: Prokaryotic cells mein konsa ribosome hota hai?
quiz_payload.explanation: 70S ribosomes! Eukaryotic mein 80S hote hain. Yaad rakho: PRO = 70 (smaller), EU = 80 (bigger).

quiz_payload.question: Konsa organism prokaryotic NAHI hai?
quiz_payload.explanation: Amoeba! Ye eukaryotic hai. Sirf bacteria aur cyanobacteria prokaryotic hote hain. Amoeba mein nucleus hai.

milestone_payload.title: 🎉 Cell Types Mastered!
milestone_payload.milestone_progress:
Prokaryotic features ✓
Eukaryotic features ✓
Ribosome types (70S vs 80S) ✓
Examples clear ✓
milestone_payload.motivational_quote: SSC aur Railway mein ye differentiation bahut puchha jata hai! Tum ab expert ho! 🎯

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Raju, cells ko measure kaise karte hain? Cm mein? Mm mein?

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Pata nahi sir... bahut chhote hote hain na?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Haan! Isliye special unit hai - MICROMETRE (μm) ya MICRON.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Kitna chhota?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: 1 mm ko 1000 parts mein baanto... ek part = 1 micron! 1 μm = 0.001 mm.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sabse bada cell kaunsa hai?

guess_payload.question: Duniya ka sabse BADA cell kaunsa hoga?
guess_payload.explanation: Ostrich egg! 170mm (17cm) tak! Egg = single cell hota hai. Ye naked eye se visible hai!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Ab sabse CHHOTA living cell - MYCOPLASMA!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Kitna chhota?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: 0.1 to 0.3 μm! Ek bacteria hai ye... ismein cell wall bhi nahi hota!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Bina cell wall ke kaise survive karta hai?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Flexible plasma membrane! Lekin human body mein sabse bada aur chhota cell pata hai?

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Nahi sir...

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
Human body:
🏆 Largest = OVUM (female egg) - 100-120 μm
🔬 Smallest = SPERM (head 5 μm)
📏 Longest = NERVE CELL - 1 metre tak!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Ek cell 1 metre ka??

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Haan! Spinal cord se paon ki ungli tak - ek hi nerve cell! ⚠️ Ye NEET/BPSC favorite hai!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Ye sab yaad kaise rakhen?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: OWM NSR: Ostrich-World largest, Ovum-human largest, Mycoplasma-Smallest, Nerve-longest, Sperm-smallest human!

quiz_payload.question: Human body ka sabse lamba cell kaunsa hai?
quiz_payload.explanation: Nerve cell (Neuron)! Ye 1 metre tak lamba ho sakta hai. Spinal cord se foot fingers tak ek hi cell hoti hai!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Tumhare ghar ki boundary wall kya kaam karti hai?

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Protection... aur kon andar aaye wo control karta hai.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Perfect! Cell ki boundary = CELL MEMBRANE (Plasma Membrane)!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Ye kya karta hai?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
1️⃣ Cell ko shape deta hai
2️⃣ Protection
3️⃣ SELECT karke materials ko andar-bahar karta hai!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Select karke matlab?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: SELECTIVELY PERMEABLE! Jaise VIP gate - sirf kuch logo ko entry! 🚪

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Oxygen andar jayega?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Haan! Glucose, water, oxygen - allowed! CO₂ waste - bahar!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Ye membrane bana kisse hai?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: LIPID (fat) + PROTEIN! Do layers mein - LIPID BILAYER.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Kisi scientist ne model banaya tha?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: SINGER & NICOLSON (1972) - FLUID MOSAIC MODEL! 🧩

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Fluid mosaic matlab?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
FLUID = Lipids aur proteins hil sakte hain (fixed nahi)
MOSAIC = Tile pattern jaisa - lipid + protein mixed!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: ⚠️ Ye BPSC/SSC mein bahut aata hai?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Haan! Model ka naam, scientist ka naam, aur year - teeno puchhe jaate hain!

quiz_payload.question: Fluid Mosaic Model kisne propose kiya?
quiz_payload.explanation: Singer & Nicolson (1972)! Ye cell membrane ki structure explain karta hai - lipid bilayer mein proteins embedded.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Raju, plant cells aur animal cells mein ek MAJOR difference hai...

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Kya sir?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: CELL WALL! Ye SIRF plants mein hota hai! Animals mein nahi! 🌱❌🐕

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Kyun nahi hota animals mein?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Kyunki animals ko movement chahiye! Rigid wall hoga to move kaise karenge?

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sahi baat! Cell wall bana kisse hai?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: CELLULOSE se! Ek complex carbohydrate - bahut strong!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Paper bhi cellulose se banta hai na?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bilkul! Paper, cotton, wood - sab mein cellulose! ⚠️ Cell wall = Membrane ke BAHAR extra layer!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Do layers hain matlab?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Haan! Pehle membrane (sabmein), uske bahar wall (sirf plants mein).

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Dono mein kya farak hai?

quiz_payload.question: Cell membrane aur cell wall mein kya difference hai?
options: Membrane sabmein, Wall sirf plants mein
Membrane plants mein, Wall animals mein
quiz_payload.explanation: Membrane = ALL cells mein (living, lipid+protein). Wall = ONLY plant cells (non-living, cellulose, rigid).

milestone_payload.title: 🎉 Cell Boundaries Clear!
milestone_payload.milestone_progress:
Selectively permeable ✓
Fluid Mosaic Model ✓
Membrane vs Wall ✓
Cellulose composition ✓
milestone_payload.motivational_quote: BPSC mein boundary structures se 3-4 questions pakke hain! Tumne master kar liya! 🔥

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Ab cell ka sabse important part - NUCLEUS! 👑

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Ye itna important kyun hai?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Company mein boss kaun hota hai? MD?

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Haan, sabse bada!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Nucleus = Cell ka MD! Saare orders yahan se! BRAIN OF THE CELL! 🧠

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Kya orders deta hai?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: DNA (genetic material) nucleus mein stored hai! Wo sab instructions deta hai!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Konse instructions?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Kaunsa protein banao, cell kab divide ho, kya kaam karo - sab kuch!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Nucleus ke kitne parts hain?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
Chaar main parts:
1️⃣ Nuclear membrane
2️⃣ Nucleoplasm
3️⃣ Nucleolus
4️⃣ Chromatin

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Ek ek karke samjhaiye na!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: NUCLEAR MEMBRANE - nucleus ki boundary! ⚠️ DOUBLE layered (cell membrane single layered tha!)

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Do layer kyun?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Extra protection! Ismein NUCLEAR PORES hain - chhote chhote darwaze!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Pores ka kaam?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Materials andar-bahar jaate hain! mRNA bahar (protein banane), proteins andar aate hain!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Nucleoplasm kya hai?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: NUCLEOPLASM = Nucleus ke andar ka jelly jaisa fluid! DNA, RNA, proteins isme tairte hain!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Aur nucleolus?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: NUCLEOLUS = Nucleus ke andar ek aur chhoti gend jaisi! ⚠️ Ye RIBOSOME FACTORY hai!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Matlab yahan ribosome bante hain?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Exactly! rRNA (ribosomal RNA) banta hai yahan! ⚠️ EXAM MUST KNOW!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Chromatin kya hota hai?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: CHROMATIN = DNA + Protein ka thread jaisa structure! Normal time mein dikhta hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Chromosome kya hai phir?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Jab cell divide hone lagti hai, chromatin TIGHTLY COIL hoke thick rod ban jata hai = CHROMOSOME! 🧬

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Matlab same cheez, different form?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Perfect! Normal time = Chromatin (thread), Division time = Chromosome (rod)! ⚠️ Dono ek saath NAHI dikhte!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Humans mein kitne chromosomes?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: 46 CHROMOSOMES! 23 pairs - 23 mother se, 23 father se!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Har organism ka alag number?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Haan! Dog = 78, Housefly = 12, Potato = 48, Rice = 24!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Zyada chromosome = zyada intelligent?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Nahi! Dog mein 78, human mein 46! Intelligence chromosome count se nahi, complexity se aati hai!

quiz_payload.question: Nucleolus ka main function kya hai?
quiz_payload.explanation: Ribosome synthesis! Nucleolus mein rRNA banta hai aur ribosome assembly hoti hai. Ye nucleus ke andar 'ribosome factory' hai!

quiz_payload.question: Statement: Chromatin aur Chromosome dono hamesha nucleus mein visible hote hain. True/False?
quiz_payload.explanation: FALSE! Normal time = Chromatin visible. Cell division = Chromosome visible. Dono ek saath nahi dikhte! Chromatin hi condense hoke chromosome banta hai.

milestone_payload.title: 🎉 Nucleus Conquered!
milestone_payload.milestone_progress:
Nuclear membrane (double layer) ✓
Nucleolus (ribosome factory) ✓
Chromatin vs Chromosome ✓
Human chromosomes (46) ✓
milestone_payload.motivational_quote: NEET mein nucleus se 5-6 questions! BPSC mein scientist names + chromatin/chromosome trap! Tum ready ho! 🚀

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Tumhara phone battery ke bina chalega?

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Nahi sir!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Cell bhi bina MITOCHONDRIA ke nahi chal sakti! Ye POWERHOUSE OF THE CELL hai! ⚡🔋

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Powerhouse matlab energy banata hai?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Exactly! Glucose ko todke ATP (energy currency) banata hai! ⚠️ Ye nickname SABSE famous hai!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Shape kaisa hai?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
Rod/Oval shape! ⚠️ DOUBLE MEMBRANE:
1️⃣ Outer - smooth
2️⃣ Inner - folded (CRISTAE)

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Cristae kyun folded?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Surface area badhane ke liye! Zyada surface = zyada ATP production! Cristae par ATP banti hai!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Andar kya hai?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: MATRIX - fluid + enzymes for respiration! ⚠️ Ab ek shocking fact...

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Mitochondria mein KHUD KA DNA hota hai! 🧬

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Hain?? DNA to nucleus mein hota hai na?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Nucleus mein bhi hai, mitochondria mein bhi! Ye khud reproduce kar sakta hai - binary fission se!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Ye to bacteria jaisa hai!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: ⚠️ UPSC LEVEL: Scientists believe mitochondria pehle free bacteria tha, baad mein cell ke andar symbiosis! = ENDOSYMBIOTIC THEORY!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Wow!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Ab RIBOSOMES - ye protein factory hain! 🏭

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Chhote hote hain?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bahut chhote! Non-membrane bound! RNA + Protein se bane! Nickname = PROTEIN FACTORY!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Kahan milte hain?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Cytoplasm mein free floating, ya ER ke surface par attached!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: 70S aur 80S wala concept yahan?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: ENDOPLASMIC RETICULUM (ER) - cell ka transport system! Jaise railway network! 🚆

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Ye kya transport karta hai?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
Proteins, lipids ko ek jagah se dusri jagah! Do types:
1️⃣ ROUGH ER (ribosomes attached)
2️⃣ SMOOTH ER (no ribosomes)

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Rough ER kya karta hai?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Protein synthesis + transport! Smooth ER = Lipid synthesis!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: GOLGI APPARATUS - packaging department! 📦 Jaise Amazon warehouse!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Kya package karta hai?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: ER se aaye proteins ko modify, pack, label karke bhejta hai! Nickname = POST OFFICE OF CELL!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Kahan bhejta hai?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Cell membrane (secretion) ya cell ke andar kisi organelle ko! Shape = Stack of pancakes! 🥞

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: LYSOSOMES - cell ka dustbin + cleaning crew! 🗑️

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Ye kya karta hai?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Digestive enzymes se waste ko digest karta hai! Nickname = SUICIDE BAGS!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Suicide bag kyun?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Agar cell damage ho jaye, lysosome phatt ke enzymes release - pura cell digest ho jata hai! Apni maut khud!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Scary!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: VACUOLES - storage tanks! 🛢️ Plant cells mein BAHUT BADA (90% space!), animal mein chhota!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Kya store karta hai?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Water, minerals, waste, food! Plant cell mein central vacuole cell ko turgor pressure deta hai (tight rakhe)!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Chloroplast kya hai?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Wo SIRF plant cells mein! ⚠️ Important hai...

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: CHLOROPLAST - food factory! 🌱 Yahan PHOTOSYNTHESIS hota hai!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Hara color iska?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Haan! CHLOROPHYLL pigment hai isme - green color! Ye sunlight capture karta hai!

quiz_payload.question: 'Suicide bags of cell' kise kehte hain?

revision_points.point: Schleiden+Schwann (cells basic unit), Virchow (new from old). Exception = Virus
Prokaryotic (No nucleus, 70S, Bacteria only) vs Eukaryotic (Nucleus, 80S, All others)
Largest = Ostrich egg, Smallest = Mycoplasma. Human: Ovum (big), Sperm (small), Nerve (long)
Membrane (All cells, lipid+protein, Fluid Mosaic). Wall (Plants only, cellulose)
Double membrane, Nucleolus (ribosome factory), Chromatin→Chromosome, Human = 46

questions.question:
Statement 1: Mitochondria has its own DNA.
Statement 2: Mitochondria can reproduce independently.

Which is correct?
options: Both true, S2 does NOT explain S1
questions.explanation: Both true! Mitochondria ka own DNA hone ki wajah se wo independently reproduce kar sakta hai (binary fission). Endosymbiotic theory!

questions.question: Which scientist gave the THIRD postulate of Cell Theory?
questions.explanation: Virchow (1855) - 'Omnis cellula-e-cellula' - all cells from pre-existing cells. BPSC favorite!

questions.question: Arrange in increasing size: (A) Mycoplasma (B) Human RBC (C) Ostrich egg
questions.explanation: Mycoplasma (0.1-0.3 μm) < RBC (7 μm) < Ostrich egg (170 mm). Size sequence NEET/BPSC mein aata hai!
